在压缩末期点燃混合气。: Ignites the mixture near the end of compression.

引导正时链，保持配气相位。: Guides the timing chain and maintains valve phase.

共同约束后轮姿态。: Locates and orients the rear wheel.
支撑车重并储存弹性能。: Supports vehicle weight and stores elastic energy.
支撑车轮并传递载荷。: Supports the wheel and transfers loads.
把齿条运动传到转向节。: Transfers rack motion to the knuckle.
把动能转变为摩擦热。: Converts kinetic energy into frictional heat.
把两块刹车片压向盘面。: Presses both pads against the disc.

供电并储存启动所需能量。: Supplies power and stores starting energy.
线圈升高电压，火花塞按点火顺序跳火。: Coils raise the voltage; plugs fire in cylinder order.

八个凸轮按升程曲线推开进气门。: Eight lobes open the intake valves with the prescribed lift law.
八个凸轮在排气冲程前后开启排气门。: Eight lobes open the exhaust valves around the exhaust stroke.
弹簧让气门持续跟随凸轮并回到阀座。: The springs keep the valves following their cams and returning to their seats.
每缸两进两排，控制气体进出。: Two intake and two exhaust valves control each cylinder.
燃烧室、进排气道和凸轮轴座铸在同一壳体里。: Combustion chambers, ports and cam bearings share one casting.
薄金属垫隔开燃烧室、水套和润滑油道。: The thin gasket seals combustion, coolant and oil passages.
活塞的直线运动通过连杆传给曲轴。: The rods transmit each piston’s linear motion to the crankshaft.
四个缸孔外是水套，下方裙部支撑五道主轴承。: Coolant jackets surround four bores; the skirt supports five main bearings.
四个曲拐把连杆往复运动变成旋转。: Four throws turn the rods’ reciprocating motion into rotation.
五个轴承盖与缸体隔板一起夹住主轴颈。: Five caps close the block’s bearing saddles around the main journals.
下方的深集油槽储存回流润滑油。: The deep sump collects returning lubricating oil.
节气门后的稳压腔通过四根弯管分配空气。: The plenum distributes air from the throttle through four curved runners.
四根独立排气管汇入同一个集气口。: Four separate exhaust runners merge into one collector.
贴着链轮轮廓的薄壳封住正时链。: The contoured front shell seals the timing chain.
20 齿曲轴轮带动两个 40 齿凸轮轴轮。: A 20-tooth crank sprocket drives two 40-tooth cam sprockets.
转动惯量平滑每次做功之间的转速起伏。: Rotational inertia smooths speed changes between power strokes.
隔开乘员舱与底部机构。: Separates the cabin from the underbody.
供乘员进出，关闭后围合座舱。: Provides cabin access and closes the passenger compartment.
覆盖缓冲结构，整合车身端部。: Covers the impact structure and completes the body end.
密封缸体与缸盖之间的燃气、水和油道。: Seals combustion, coolant and oil passages between the head and block.
封住链条并保持润滑油在壳体内。: Encloses the chain and retains lubricating oil.
封住气门机构并容纳润滑油。: Encloses the valve mechanism and contains oil.
把曲轴主轴颈约束在轴线上。: Holds the main journal on the crank axis.
控制气缸的进排气通道。: Controls gas flow into or out of the cylinder.
储存转动能量，平滑各缸的动力脉冲。: Stores rotational energy and smooths firing pulses.
把进入的空气分配给四个气缸。: Distributes incoming air to four cylinders.
汇集四个气缸排出的废气。: Collects exhaust from all four cylinders.
固定轴承和齿轮轴，容纳润滑油。: Locates bearings and shafts and contains lubricating oil.
用摩擦把飞轮动力传给输入轴。: Transfers flywheel torque to the input shaft through friction.
压紧摩擦片，换挡时退开。: Clamps the friction disc and releases it during shifts.
22 齿输入齿轮始终带动中间轴。: The 22-tooth input gear continuously drives the layshaft.
32 齿齿轮与中间轴固定在一起。: The 32-tooth gear is fixed to the layshaft.
随中间轴转动，持续驱动对应空套齿轮。: Rotates with the layshaft and continuously drives its free gear.
一直旋转，结合套锁住它才驱动输出轴。: Always spins; drives the output shaft only when locked by its sleeve.
多一次外啮合，使输出轴反向。: Adds a mesh to reverse the output shaft.
沿输出轴滑动，把选中齿轮锁到轴上。: Slides along the output shaft to lock the selected gear.
拨动结合套，在空挡和齿轮间切换。: Moves its sleeve between neutral and a gear.
连接左右悬架，限制车身侧倾。: Connects the left and right suspension to resist body roll.
通过接地面传递驱动、制动和转向力。: Transfers drive, braking and cornering forces at the contact patch.
支承轮胎，把载荷传给轮毂。: Supports the tire and transfers loads to the hub.
把发动机的机械能转化成电能。: Converts engine rotation into electrical energy.
用电池能量带动发动机开始转动。: Uses battery energy to crank the engine.
把曲轴的转动传给发电机。: Transfers crank rotation to the alternator.
从曲轴取出附件驱动动力。: Takes accessory-drive power from the crankshaft.
让发电机以曲轴约 2.7 倍的转速运行。: Turns the alternator at about 2.7 times crank speed.
所有齿轮一直咬在一起转，换挡只是把其中一个锁到输出轴上。: All the gears stay in mesh. Shifting only locks one of them to the output shaft.
车轮悬空；车速按轮胎滚动半径计算。同步器转速匹配为运动学示意。: Wheels are suspended; speed uses the rolling radius. Synchronizer speed matching is an idealized motion.
齿轮常啮合，换挡只锁一个。: Always in mesh. Lock one gear.
沿琥珀色路径，看动力怎样抵达后轮。: Follow the amber path from the input shaft to the rear wheels.
11 齿小轮随传动轴旋转。: The 11-tooth pinion rotates with the propeller shaft.
41 齿齿圈降速增矩，带动差速器。: The 41-tooth ring reduces speed and drives the differential.
支承轴并减小旋转摩擦。: Supports a shaft and reduces rotational friction.
浮动卡钳只有内侧一个活塞，外侧那片是整个卡钳滑过来夹住的。: A floating caliper has one piston on the inside. The whole caliper slides to pull the outer pad against the disc.
夹紧力 = 压力 × 活塞面积；每盘力矩 = 2 × 0.40 × 夹紧力 ×: Clamp force = pressure × piston area. Disc torque = 2 × 0.40 × clamp force × effective radius.
间隙与滑动量放大 20 倍。管路高亮用 0.3 秒解释动作先后，不表示液压传播速: Gaps and sliding travel are enlarged 20×. The 0.3-second line highlight illustrates sequence, not hydraulic propagation speed.
固定摩擦系数与四轮同压制动；减速度以 1.0 g 附着上限封顶，ABS 为限幅示: Fixed friction and equal line pressure at all four wheels. Deceleration is capped at 1.0 g; ABS is illustrated by this adhesion limit.
转弯时外侧轮要多走一段路，差速器让左右轮可以转得不一样快。: The outside wheel travels farther in a turn. The differential lets the two wheels rotate at different speeds.
理想阿克曼，不计轮胎侧偏。车速取后轴中心；画面保持车身原地，轮速按各自轨迹计算。: Ideal Ackermann, with no tyre slip angle. Road speed is measured at the rear-axle centre; the car stays in place while each wheel follows its own path speed.
两对等角万向节消除转速波动。桥内为直齿锥齿轮示意，未模拟真实准双曲面齿面。: The equal-angle universal-joint pair cancels speed fluctuation. The axle uses illustrative straight bevel teeth, not production hypoid surfaces.
齿圈 = 左右后轮平均；行星自转 = 轮速差 ÷ 2 × 16/10。: Ring speed = rear-wheel average. Planet spin = half the speed difference × 16/10.

弹簧吸收冲击，减振器把弹簧的来回晃动耗掉。: The spring absorbs the impact; the damper dissipates its back-and-forth motion.
两自由度四分之一车，线性弹簧和阻尼；连杆姿态为示意，不计算侧倾和轮胎离地。: Two-degree-of-freedom quarter-car model with a linear spring and damper. Link positions are illustrative; roll and tyre lift-off are not modelled.
利用压差放大踏板推力。: Uses a pressure differential to amplify pedal force.

为总泵补充制动液。: Supplies brake fluid to the master cylinder.
调节轮缸压力；本模型以附着限幅表示介入。: Modulates wheel pressure; this model represents intervention as an adhesion limit.
连接总泵和 ABS 液压单元。: Connects the master cylinder to the ABS hydraulic unit.
压力乘活塞面积得到推向内片的力。: Pressure times piston area gives the force on the inner pad.
密封液压腔并在松开时帮助活塞回位。: Seals the hydraulic chamber and helps retract the piston after release.
由活塞推出并摩擦盘的内侧。: The piston pushes this pad against the inner disc face.
由浮动钳体反向滑动拉向盘的外侧。: The sliding caliper body pulls this pad against the outer disc face.
让钳体沿盘轴线自由滑动。: Lets the caliper body slide along the disc axis.
把刹车片与导向销定位在转向节上。: Locates the brake pads and guide pins on the steering knuckle.
把同一管路压力传到对应车轮。: Carries line pressure to the corresponding wheel.
镀层钢管与增强软管: Coated steel tubing and reinforced hose
把轮毂、摆臂和减振器连接起来，承受轮端载荷。: Joins the hub, control arms and damper and carries wheel loads.
允许摆臂和轮端之间改变角度。: Allows the control arm and wheel carrier to change their relative angle.
硬化钢与橡胶防尘套: Hardened steel and rubber dust boot
在固定长度的减振器筒内伸缩，把悬架运动传给内部阻尼活塞。: Slides inside the fixed-length damper body and transfers suspension motion to its internal piston.
定位螺旋弹簧并把弹簧力传给悬架。: Locates the coil spring and transfers its force into the suspension.
转向决定轨迹，差速器分配左右轮速。: Steering sets the paths. The differential lets wheel speeds differ.
从液压到摩擦，动能变成热。: Hydraulic pressure creates friction. Motion becomes heat.
弹簧承受冲击，阻尼让振动停下来。: Springs absorb the impact. Damping settles the motion.
